title: How to organise the dresser drawers | Primary Bedroom
description:
These drawers hold the folded clothes you wear this season, split into categories you can find without digging.

This is the Dresser Drawers in the Primary Bedroom. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Each drawer holds one category: underwear and socks, sleepwear, t-shirts, workout clothes. Everything folded to stand upright so you read the whole drawer from above when it opens. A hand's width of free space in each drawer, and every drawer slides shut without you pressing anything down first.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Tip one drawer at a time onto the bed.
Straighten: Fold everything so it stands on its edge and the drawer reads like a row of files instead of a stack you excav
Shine: Empty each drawer completely, vacuum the corners and the runners, wipe the base, and let it dry before anythin
Safety: Open one drawer at a time.
Standardize: One category per drawer, and a hand's width of free space is the fill line.
Sustain: When the clean laundry comes back to the bedroom, it gets folded upright and put into the drawer then, rather

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One category per drawer, folded to stand upright, and a hand's width of free space kept as the fill line.
